sections.scope: CCU definitions and Strategy CCUS scope

sections.scope: 1.2 Checmical carbon capture and utilization concepts [native heading spelling]
sections.assessment: Read methanation/gasoline, methanol, algae, BECCS, mineralization, cement, food, horticulture and polymers. Temporary product uptake/re-emission and biogenic uptake differ from durable geological storage. Three-options wording precedes four numbered items; no exhaustive taxonomy inferred.

Read multiple-contact miscibility, condensing/vaporizing mechanisms, swelling, mobility, produced CO2 and economic case studies. Commercial feasibility, NPV 244 million wording and CO2 price assumptions require exact originals; no net climate credit derived.

Read 168 facilities, commercial/pilot categories, six status classes, Sleipner/Texas chronology and projected growth. Snapshot all-status facilities and cumulative/projected injection projects have different time/category bases. No fitted growth model or current 2026 database verified.

Read ten regional plus two external sources, 12 identities, 2018 emissions, sectors, trends, stack counts, fuels, process/biogenic fractions and urban space. Multiple stacks are not one uniform capture stream. No measured capture fractions/complete utilities; future closures and permissions unverified.

Read new pipelines along natural-gas corridors, roads/rail, Viridas and glass low-flow cases, urban TE-TO/EL-TO uncertainty. Existing gas pipelines are not assumed repurposed. Right-of-way proximity, qualitative modal recommendations and an existing EOR link do not certify new or reversed CO2 service.

Read Sava/Drava rifting, subsidence, compression/inversion, facies, faults and schematic stratigraphy. All 19 assets are described as Tier 2; historical hydrocarbon containment and regional correlation do not establish current CO2 pressure/fracture/fault qualification.

Read five DSAs, Table 1 and theoretical caveat. Drava/Osijek 2048.8 Mt round to 2049; Sava 535.7 round to 536. Trap definitions, storage efficiency, pressure boundaries and injectivity remain unprovided. Five mapped DSAs are not five qualified operating stores.

Read 14 DHF, resource replacement basis, depth/lithology/dates, spatial grouping and EOR-before-depletion option. Table 2 sums 143.6 Mt; rounded Figure 11 labels sum 146. Regional 113+31 and Eastern 23 have precision/membership qualifications; no corrected source total substituted.

Read ten Table 3 criteria and seven conceptual oil-field models. Confidential detailed static/well data absent. Production/final reservoir pressure were matched; production projected to 2025 and EOR until 2040. Exact histories, controls, PVT, SCAL, MMP and calibration residuals unavailable.

Read 175 km criterion, Eastern three sources/two fields, Central seven sources/two hub alternatives, and Adriatic two large sources. New corridor pipelines and staged oil-to-gas/DSA storage are conceptual alternatives, not solved route/capacity/cost optima. Some geographic/stream labels remain unclear.

Read all 63 numeric/token cells, min/max/mean units, gross injection, produced/vented CO2 and oil. Common 2025 start explicitly not optimized. Average bookkeeping does not identify paired annual extrema or safe service; literal Lipovljani emitted minimum 0 23 stays unparsed.

Read Eastern priority, onshore-only economics, capture challenge, cross-border imports, DSA/EOR transition and study limitations. Conclusion 100 km criterion differs from 175 km body; two DSA wording needs scope. Undoubted cost reduction and eligibility claims lack an optimized network/current legal verification.

claims.claim: Policy and public support may improve CCS investment feasibility.
claims.assessment: Literature argument, not causal deployment evidence or a calibrated Croatian investment model.

claims.claim: A CCS Directive and Croatian monitoring/liability obligations shape licensing.
claims.assessment: Exact law unverified. Native bibliography pointer 2009/28/EC needs original confirmation before describing binding CCS requirements.

claims.claim: EU ETS allowance supply, banking and MSR influence prices and investment.
claims.assessment: Historical account, not a current legal update or price forecast. The 2.2% statement is not verified observed annual CO2 abatement.

claims.claim: Market pull, technology push and policy push motivate CCU.
claims.assessment: Source framing and definitions, without verified empirical weights or a complete utilization-market model.

claims.claim: Capture technologies differ in efficiency, oxygen, cooling and cost.
claims.assessment: Generic claims need original process cases. No matched capture-to-ship heat/electricity inventory supplied.

claims.claim: Capture costs vary with source, size, technology, boundary and method.
claims.assessment: Figures 1/2 use 2015 USD; Figure 3 uses 2014 EUR and single-facility separation/compression. No pooling into a current whole-chain factor.

claims.claim: DAC processes large air volumes and capture materials remain important.
claims.assessment: Cited technical claims unverified; no original DAC/material model or complete energy inventory reproduced.

claims.claim: The review covers methanation, gasoline, methanol, algae and BECCS.
claims.assessment: Product substitution, temporary uptake, biogenic regrowth and durable storage differ. No automatic negative emissions inferred.

claims.claim: Mineralization, concrete, horticulture and polymers are discussed as utilization routes.
claims.assessment: The 1.4 Gt/30-year, >75% release and up-to-50% uptake claims need original scope. Ravikumar title warns net benefit may not occur; no climate credit transferred.

claims.claim: Miscible EOR changes oil viscosity, mobility, swelling and production.
claims.assessment: Mechanisms are qualitative here; PVT, relative permeability, withdrawals and pressure controls are needed for forecasts.

claims.claim: Published EOR cases may be economic under different CO2 and oil prices.
claims.assessment: Native NPV 244 million threshold wording and cost/credit definitions need originals. Revenue is not climate benefit.

claims.claim: CO2RE 2021 lists 168 facilities across categories and regions.
claims.assessment: Both pie panels sum to 100%. Status stacks and cumulative projections are not verified 2026 operating capacity.

claims.claim: Texas EOR and Sleipner mark early deployment milestones.
claims.assessment: Chronology and first-project claims need exact definitions and original sources.

claims.claim: Cumulative project growth is projected through 2035.
claims.assessment: No growth fit or uncertainty provided. Historical, projected and all-status populations need compatible definitions.

claims.claim: Ten regional and two outside emitters make twelve sources.
claims.assessment: Approximate 2018/snapshot inventory and future closures, not current captured flow or timestamped operations.

claims.claim: Six power plants and two refineries contribute about 67% of emissions.
claims.assessment: Rounded Figure 8 values give 3.73/5.54 = 67.33%. The 5.53 body total differs within displayed rounding.

claims.claim: NEXE, Petrokemija, Molve, glass and Adriatic facilities have important emissions.
claims.assessment: Retain native 0.65, 0.75, 0.29, about 0.1 and 1.2/1.0 Mt/y with source vintage. No capture fraction or upstream factor inferred.

claims.claim: Some facilities grow or decline; Plomin 210 MWe is described as permitted until 2040.
claims.assessment: Dated strategy, media and ministerial sources require present project/legal confirmation; no guaranteed future capture feed.

claims.claim: Stacks, fuel, biomass/process fractions and space affect capture.
claims.assessment: Sisak 19/Molve 14 points and cement 65% process emissions are secondary data. No uniform capture unit or automatic biogenic climate credit.

claims.claim: New CO2 pipelines could follow existing natural-gas corridors.
claims.assessment: Explicitly distinct from repurposing gas pipelines. Corridor proximity does not prove permission, integrity, capacity or optimal cost.

claims.claim: Road transport may suit small Viridas/glass flows; Zagreb routes remain uncertain.
claims.assessment: Qualitative recommendation around 0.1 Mt/y, without solved modal TEA, reliability or regulatory permission.

claims.claim: Sava and Drava facies and tectonic evolution influence storage prospects.
claims.assessment: Adapted schematics do not calibrate depth, permeability or fault safety. TWT seconds, BNg and angular markers retain limitations.

claims.claim: Nineteen assets comprise fourteen DHFs and five DSAs, all described as Tier 2.
claims.assessment: Maturity classes do not certify qualified capacity or annual service; neighboring units may interact hydraulically.

claims.claim: Drava/Osijek offer about 2049 Mt and three Sava DSAs about 536 Mt.
claims.assessment: Table 1 sums are 2048.8 and 535.7 Mt. Traps and dynamic constraints remain unresolved.

claims.claim: Regional DSA stocks could cover emissions of 5.53 Mt/y.
claims.assessment: Stock size cannot establish injectivity, pressure limits, availability or operating duration. Native capacity-formula inputs unavailable.

claims.claim: Fourteen DHFs are reported to provide 146 Mt of storage.
claims.assessment: Table 2 sums to 143.6 Mt. Individually rounded Figure 11 labels sum to 146; preserve both bases without correcting the underlying model.

claims.claim: Regional groups are described as nine Eastern fields/113 Mt and five Central fields/31 Mt.
claims.assessment: Their 144 Mt total is near 143.6. Exact membership absent; do not invent an 8/6 reassignment from numerical totals.

claims.claim: Molve and Kalinovac provide about 74 Mt and past hydrocarbon containment raises confidence.
claims.assessment: Table 2 gives 74.4 Mt. Hydrocarbon history does not prove CO2 geomechanical safety or full qualification.

claims.claim: Depletion dates vary, and EOR may precede pure storage.
claims.assessment: Forecast dates are not current availability; delayed 2021 depletion is acknowledged. Earlier EOR is not automatically inconsistent with later CCS readiness.

claims.claim: Seven oil fields were screened using ten criteria.
claims.assessment: Actual candidate measurements and certainty grades are absent from Table 3; generic thresholds do not verify all pass.

claims.claim: Screening includes density <920, viscosity <10, saturation >20, depth >760 and porosity >11.
claims.assessment: CN % versus C 5–C 12 and blank porosity units are unresolved. Top depths 727/750 m may differ from screening interval depth; no automatic failed-screen conclusion.

claims.claim: Conceptual compositional Eclipse models use volumetric, rock and PVT properties.
claims.assessment: Detailed static/well data explicitly confidential. Decks, controls, SCAL, residuals and uncertainty unavailable; not independently reproduced.

claims.claim: Production/final pressure were matched, with production to 2025 and EOR through 2040.
claims.assessment: Calibration is not independent prediction validation. No timestamped pressure/rate series, native safety cap or geomechanical validation.

claims.claim: Ivanić/Žutica PVT studies inform models; other fields use estimated MMP.
claims.assessment: Original slim-tube studies, correlations, compositions and state bases need verification. MMP is not maximum safe injection pressure.

claims.claim: Three clusters use geographic proximity, with a 175 km body criterion.
claims.assessment: Conclusion also mentions 100 km. Routed-distance definition and feasibility rule remain unresolved.

claims.claim: Eastern emissions are 0.86 Mt/y and Beničanci/Bokšić are assigned 23 Mt.
claims.assessment: Decimal stocks total 22.4 Mt; rounded bars total 23. Their 26.05/26.74-year stock/rate quotients are not validated service or operating life.

claims.claim: Eastern links of 18–65 km may avoid an upstream consolidation hub.
claims.assessment: Authors spatial judgment, without hydraulic, cost, pressure, robustness or permission validation.

claims.claim: Central has seven sources, 2.5 Mt/y and about 8500 km2 with two hub scenarios.
claims.assessment: Ivanja Reka/Stružec and oil-to-gas alternatives are not a solved global optimizer. Molve power-plant/NGPP wording remains ambiguous.

claims.claim: Molve emissions could decline and an existing Molve-to-western-Sava link may support connections.
claims.assessment: Reverse flow requires its own control, design and permission evidence. Existing links/corridors do not establish unlimited capacity.

claims.claim: Adriatic sources could join Central hubs or use hydrocarbon/DSA stores.
claims.assessment: Onshore-only scope, distances and westward wording need route confirmation. Ready-to-transport wording is not zero capture duty or a specified product state.

claims.claim: Common 2025 EOR starts simplify comparison.
claims.assessment: Authors explicitly do not optimize timing or utilization. Most-efficient wording does not establish globally optimal starts or hubs.

claims.claim: Table 4 gives injection, emissions and oil min/max/average values.
claims.assessment: All 63 cells inspected; twenty unambiguous metric ranges have ordered means. Lipovljani minimum 0 23 stays unparsed; extrema are not paired.

claims.claim: Any two or three fields could store Central/Eastern emissions.
claims.assessment: Universal mean-rate reading fails: gross Lipovljani + Žutica is 2.124 <3.36 Mt/y; net Kloštar + Lipovljani + Žutica is 2.713 <3.36. All 224 screens preserve basis and target.

claims.claim: Produced/vented CO2 averages 40–60% of injection and overall net reduction is around 40%.
claims.assessment: Means total 29.384 injected, 17.027 produced and 12.357 Mt/y unproduced: 42.05%. Lipovljani 29.09% produced is a field exception. Aggregate and unweighted averages differ; not lifecycle avoidance.

claims.claim: Mean unproduced rates range from about 0.2 to 3.2 Mt/y.
claims.assessment: Mean differences span 0.195–3.251 Mt/y assuming common weights/window. No actual net extrema, annual safe service or permanence verified.

claims.claim: Recovering produced CO2 would reduce fresh-capture requirements.
claims.assessment: Analyst recovery 0/0.5/1 holds gross rates fixed and conserves mass. Recovery energy, impurities, cost, dynamics and pressure responses are unmodeled.

claims.claim: Operating full selected EOR scenarios may require external CO2 supplies.
claims.assessment: Conditional benchmark demand, not the minimum size or necessary import level of a Croatian network. Scaling, capture, recycling and availability matter.

claims.claim: EOR is not recognized under ETS/Green Taxonomy in the authors account.
claims.assessment: Historical statement, not verified 2026 eligibility. Exact rules, permanent-storage conditions, venting and project facts need originals.

claims.claim: Clustering would reduce costs and Eastern is the earliest priority.
claims.assessment: Conditional recommendation and economic intuition, without a presented cluster CAPEX/OPEX comparison, optimized network or verified implementation date.

claims.claim: Cross-border, EOR-to-storage and injection-dynamics studies are needed.
claims.assessment: Explicit future work; no cross-border pressure model, present legal eligibility or full climate benefit established.

claims.claim: Conclusion mentions two DSAs while Table 1 lists five.
claims.assessment: Eastern Drava/Osijek focus may explain scope; wording unresolved. No deletion or merger of Sava units.

claims.claim: Most data are described as public/visible, with more in project deliverables.
claims.assessment: Exact reports/decks unverified. Statement does not supply confidential static/well assets or establish model reproducibility.

claims.claim: Funding, eight author contributions and no known competing interests are disclosed.
claims.assessment: Native disclosures read without independent conflict assessment. All-rights-reserved notice preserved.

claims.claim: Static DHF stocks and dynamic EOR means need common-case reconciliation.
claims.assessment: Mean times fifteen years is an analyst screen. Dynamic withdrawal/composition and static replacement bases may differ; no automatic physical-capacity violation inferred.

claims.claim: Paper 1 must separate stocks, intake, retention, revenue and whole-chain avoidance.
claims.assessment: No public pressure-constrained annual field dataset or complete capture-to-ship inventory supplied. New quantities stay outside accepted inputs.

claims.claim: All 59 bibliography entries and the unlisted Brezovac source remain unverified originals.
claims.assessment: Transcription is not primary reading, citation-chain closure, SI inspection or native-model reproduction. No exact cited DOI matched another retained main PDF; no new primary edge.
